entities.summary: Yin Junhua is a Chinese boxer from Xingtai. She won a silver medal in the women's lightweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics, losing to Estelle Mossely by a split decision in the final. Yin Junhua was a athletes & competitors from Xingtai (b. 1990-08-27, Xingtai). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
